archetypes.name: dyn-oos-counts
archetypes.rationale: OOS proposed/fileable split crosses metadata, rendering, and classification paths.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect the changed progress-report OOS count flow. Focus on legacy metadata, review-tally.env precedence, classification severity parsing, and security-tagged OOS exclusion. Check that proposed totals and fileable counts cannot overwrite each other in canonical metadata or rendered tables. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
